chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Cab Calloway calls after Chu Berry's accident
summary: Cab's manager found McRae on Broadway and sent him to Toronto and Montreal, where he learned Berry had died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And I was around New York the year that Chu Berry had that accident. And the day that he had the accident, Cab Calloway knew he needed a tenor player, and so he wired Mittler, his manager, 1619 Broadway, to come in --
Mittler. He's a Jewish fella, I think. We'll probably see him (inaudible) in some of his Cab Calloway things, but I'll bring it to you.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
He wanted a tenor player to take Chu Berry's place. So, I had been gigging and writing with Sid Wycher and different writers writing the rock and roll.
I think I went down at Wheeler Music with Sid Wycher (Unaudible) was doing a lot of things.
So I was walking up Broadway and here come Cab's manager running down the street. He say, "I need you, I need you."
He says, "Did you hear about Chu Berry's accident?"
I say, "No. Yeah, I heard something on the air about he got out of the car or the car slid or something."
He says, "Well he's in the hospital very sick in Ohio. I want you to join Cab in Montreal."
Toronto, when we play the band in First night I went there. Toronto (Inaudible). And the next time we went to Montreal.
And that was the night when we went to Montreal, that's when we got the news that Chu Berry had passed away.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
But I didn't really want to go out on the road because I just had gotten back from an ordeal. I wanted to stay in town and help raise the kids, you know, (inaudible).
And I didn't feel like going, but knowing Cab -- he saym "You know you and Cab get along good. You like Cab and likes you." We all just talking and carrying on.
I say, "Yeah, but"-- I say, "Look, I just came off a long trip."
I say, "I'm just trying to get into something else. I want to do some writing and I m gonna study some more."

He says, "Well go up and help Cab out for a couple of weeks, you know." He got these theaters and when you come back, you can make your mind up if you wanna stay with the band or if you don't want to stay (inaudible)."
